_comment: F9 replay provenance: spec pins for cassettes recorded before the harness stored the spec in the cassette meta. The architect, red-team and lead requests embed the example spec; the harness used to read it from the CURRENT checkout's documentation/examples, so a replay after a docs edit (6bebe01 rewrote 04-09) diverged at those sites, differently per checkout. A pin is matched by the cassette meta's exact (frozen_now, model); its spec text is read from git at examples_sha and must hash to spec_sha256[example] (sha256 of the UTF-8 spec text, spec_mode full). New recordings carry spec_text/spec_sha256 in their meta and need no pin.
